newsitem.title: USA: Westwood One in pact with CBS Radio.
newsitem.headline: Westwood One in pact with CBS Radio.

text.p: Westinghouse Inc's CBS said Monday that it has entered into an agreement for Westwood One Inc to represent and manage the assets of CBS Radio Networks.

Under the deal, CBS Radio will continue to produce and control programming it provides to Westwood, which was the broadcasting unit of Infinity Broadcasting Corp. Infinity was purchased last year by Westinghouse.
In turn, Westwood is to manage the sales, marketing and promotion, affiliate relations, research and administration for CBS Radio Networks programming.
CBS Radio Chairman and Chief Executive Mel Karmazin is also president and chief executive of Westwood. Karmazin was the founder of Infinity.
Westwood, the second largest U.S. radio network, produces and distributes nationally-sponsored programs.
Westwood said the additional revenues generated from the CBS programming, as well as the efficiencies from the consolidation, will be immediately accretive to its cash flow.
The companies did not immediately return a telephone call seeking further information.
